limits: Native raw-FP32 neural and final integer-coder distributions are separate measurement levels; DeltaF-DeltaN is not causal mixer loss.
Fixed checkpoints localize deterioration; do not prove surrogate-Jacobian causality or select a remedy.
Exposed development250KB only. No full-corpus extrapolation, package promotion or 96M score credit. Preserve P as scale comparator and bounded P/J delivery totals.
Observer adds diagnostic time, memory and disk; measured resource verdict applies to this observer gate, not release qualification.
Fixed two-copy model economics remain in original training/delivery receipts; observer code and duplicate research archives are not a new prize package.

policy.capture: Observe native FP32 output before half conversion. Retain previous output until current target arrives; first target and first after piece-ending lack a native prediction. Capture actual Q16 p and truth at arithmetic coder input for all eight bits of every modeled byte.
policy.comparisons: DeltaN and DeltaF are X minus P, summed within each measurement level only. Epsilon=8*(archive_X-archive_P)-DeltaF(all), an observed coding/framing residual.
policy.controls: Every observed archive must be byte-identical to its retained unobserved archive. Independent inverse and repeat must reproduce all four capture files exactly. Verify coded bytes independently map to bound tokens and resets.
policy.mask: Four unchanged training starts; target intervals [513,641),[3124,3252),[40225,40353),[69372,69500), 512 distinct modeled-token targets. Prediction rows target-1. Original tokens, markers and PPM priors identity bound.
policy.partitions: Trained512, complement of other neural-eligible targets, and no-neural targets. No neural cost imputed on no-neural partition. All final coded events retained.
policy.population: Previously exposed development raw[0,250000); original 151210 modeled bytes. All P/A/J complete native trajectories from declared initialization, no analysis-partition resets.
policy.stop: Run P/A/J unchanged, including valid losses. Stop on missing identities, alignment, inverse, repeat, original archive equivalence or resource failure. No training, checkpoint selection, metadata, confirmation access or larger run.
policy.window_check: Compare all512 truth probabilities against retained same-checkpoint native window evaluations, and compare full PPM prior stream with original training capture. Differences diagnose history/priors/reset/coordinate issues; do not tune them away.

resource_basis: CPU2,10GB resident and zero swap in owned cgroup;32GiB virtual for unchanged sparse PPM mapping;18GB logical scratch;9 bounded codec phases and one build;1800s total stop. Each subprocess CPU240s/wall260s. Shared-host diagnostic.
